meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会拿到一个真实电话号码:能收发短信、用 AI 接听语音来电,两个方向都走 dial CLI。需要登录 Dial 账号,并把你的手机配对成功后才能真正对话。
howto.when: 当你要求给 Claude 添加 Dial 电话通道(短信 + AI 语音)、安装 Dial 集成时触发;它会复制适配器和测试、装依赖、重新构建并重启服务。

say.text: 帮我给 Claude 加一个 Dial 号码,能收短信也能接电话
say.note: 会复制 Dial 适配器、装依赖、构建并重启服务

say.text: 这条 Dial 线路接电话时先问好,再记录对方姓名和来电原因
say.note: 把这段设成该号码的来电问候提示词

say.text: 只允许我配对的那个手机号给这条线发短信
say.note: 未配对的发信人会被拒绝

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gets a real phone number: it can send and receive SMS and answer AI voice calls, both directions going through the dial CLI. You sign in to a Dial account and pair your phone before conversations work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Dial phone channel (SMS + AI voice) to Claude or install the Dial integration; it copies the adapter and tests, installs deps, rebuilds and restarts the service.

say_en.text: Add a Dial number for Claude that can receive SMS and take calls
say_en.note: Copies the Dial adapter, installs deps, builds, restarts

say_en.text: Make the Dial line greet callers, then take their name and reason
say_en.note: Sets the inbound system prompt for that number

say_en.text: Only let the phone I paired text this line
